newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Jan-Sep trade surplus widens to $17.2 bln.
newsitem.headline: Russian Jan-Sep trade surplus widens to $17.2 bln.

text.p: Russia posted a trade surplus of $17.2 billion in the first nine months of this year after a $17.0 billion surplus in the same period of 1995, the State Statistic Committee said on Thursday.
The committee said data was preliminary and included imports by small private traders.
RUSSIAN MERCHANDISE TRADE Jan-Sept96 Jan-Aug96 Jan-Sept95

Notes -- Figures in billion dollars, FOB. Data are for trade with Russia's "far abroad", excluding former Soviet states. January-September trade balance with former Soviet republics was negative and widened to $1.4 billion from $800 million last year.
